decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s core infrared-heating offer, it is likely to be retained unless sales clearly fell short of aspiration levels, though its limited visibility suggests only moderate commitment.
Its dedicated product page indicates stronger managerial commitment and likely satisfactory early results, so in a growing market the firm has little reason to redeploy resources away from it.

This product appears to be a less prominent variant in an already narrow and overlapping range, so if its performance lagged aspiration levels the firm would likely reallocate resources to stronger core lines.
Because it is a full product line with several models in the firm’s established core business, management would be inclined to keep it unless there were clear and persistent performance shortfalls.
A standard plaque heater with its own page fits the firm’s established portfolio and likely serves as a dependable baseline offering, making retention more likely than withdrawal.

Given the apparent overlap with the broader tube-heater line and the firm’s probably limited slack, management would be prone to drop this narrower offering if it did not clearly meet aspiration levels.
